set.body:
Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 3, 4.3-4.4, 6; minimal court D. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: M1 implementation.
Integration parent: bd-01M16KDH0TM7DF2BC0K08TH0TT; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7ANWFHMXQJJRJ996WBG2.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own workspace bar, investigation rail, two primary modes, inspector host and optional dock in the existing Laminar shell. Reuse Codex/Atlas reading and edition constants. Apply mockup paper/evergreen tokens, readable typography and responsive drawer rules without changing pinned publication metrics.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Source-only opens into useful reading without a blank matrix; adding compatible recall preserves source identity/reading position, wrong edition refuses.
2. Minimal supplied labels, lookup/reveal, Back/Return, direct/proxy/off-projection feedback and exact text copying work on both M1 fixtures.
3. At desktop/narrow/200% layouts controls remain reachable, text is not shrunk to fit, and resize changes no scientific state. Checksums/horizons are available as printed details.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Keep current reader wrappers, exact text and edition preset; new shell styling is separable from compilers.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [M1] Mount the shared shell and minimal source-only reading
